verifiedFacts: PDF p.2 (printed 1): 'Last updated on 2.1.2026'; contents list marks PART B as '(to be tested during Basic Theory Test)'.
PDF p.11 (printed 10): Stop = 'Stop before the white line. Give way to traffic from the right and left'; Give Way = 'Slow down. Stop if necessary. Give way to traffic on major road'.
PDF p.36 (printed 35) §52(a)/(b): parallel broken white lines = give way to traffic on a major road; single white line = stop close to and before the line.
PDF p.45 (printed 44) §58: circular RED/AMBER/FLASHING AMBER/GREEN/GREEN ARROW/FLICKERING GREEN ARROW meanings.
PDF p.46 (printed 45): GREEN 'B' is for buses only; GREEN/AMBER/RED ARROW meanings; red arrow: do not turn right even when there is no traffic from the opposite direction.
PDF p.47 (printed 46): worked examples where circular green means GO straight ahead while the right-turn arrow is amber or red.
PDF p.53 (printed 52) §81–82: Give Way rule at junctions with a major road and priority at uncontrolled junctions.
unresolved: The handbook carries a reproduction notice; page crops are research references, not licensed product assets.
The handbook does not state the BTT question count, pass mark or paper format; no exam format is asserted anywhere in content/**.
